proved_within_fixture_scope: AI tool selection is not authorization
unknown permission blocks the action edge and opens a required Attached permission Sequence
denied permission can be a successful/accepted decision return while the action threshold remains false
granted permission causes threshold re-evaluation rather than bypass
source-bound Engine failure blocks the parent
repair and retest use separate Sequence IDs
repair success does not equal retest success
dependent edge is re-evaluated only after accepted PASS retest return
no in-place retry and no closed Sequence reopen

non_claim: These deterministic synthetic-fixture tests prove encoded Sourceborn control-law behavior only. They do not prove real-world tool safety, Engine implementation correctness, external truth, or Phase-2 closure.
